prefill.scenario: Independent post-formal QCP8/EP8 16K natural-routing BF16-selector diagnostic; CPU+GPU8steps; default autotune

extra_decoder_tail.scope: Whole eight captured forwards; query chunks, not extra logical input tokens. Kernel totals do not equal critical-path cost.

limits: Observed activity is not SM occupancy or saturation.
All eight imports reported CPU complete-event nesting overflow; raw/import category counts and GPU geometry separately checked.
Representative 16K trace does not explain the 4K slow interval or DP8 smooth decline.
Reference and profile windows cover different requests; observed delta is not a pure profiler overhead estimate.
No UI inspection or hardware-counter capture.

decode.scope: Independent diagnostic; original formal measurements and global audit remain unchanged. This is not a new performance score or a fix.

critical_path.operator: DeepEP elastic 80-row dispatch and its PDL release
critical_path.epilogue_interpretation: Overlaps producer dispatch and waits for PDL release; do not add its residence to dispatch.

gpu_geometry.interpretation: No large device-wide idle gap in this captured interval. Activity coverage is not occupancy or useful compute.

gc.scope: Excludes direct GC pause for these observed intervals, not every original formal peak.

cpu.scope: Actual worker cgroup matches sampler. Visible controller only; hidden ancestors, nonrunnable waits and unidentified proxy roles remain unobserved. 1s schedstat is not a scheduler trace.

rdma.scope: Port-wide approximately1s observations; not perQP or sub-step. Request counters stayed flat, so their coverage is unproven. No PFC-specific counters. ECN/CNP does not by itself identify congestion as this tail cause.

capture_completeness.qualification: Failed partial diagnostic generation; surviving complete traces can support bounded local analysis, not16rank capture qualification.

profiler_boundary_failure.failure: GIN barrier timeout followed by CUDA719 during profile stop/export
profiler_boundary_failure.interpretation: Separate observer-boundary failure; not proof of the original unprofiled tail cause.

validation.overflow_warning_scope: Overlapping complete-event hierarchy/layout ambiguity retained; no lost-event claim from these warnings.

limitations: Internal initial/final barrier, GIN transfer/progress and missing rank15 GPU late arrival are not distinguished.
Normal and slow intervals use different decode positions and natural token routes; identical graph and launch shape does not prove identical payload or route load.
Profiler perturbs execution. This selected interval begins about1.94s after firstGPU event and over30s before stop; the boundary guard is not proof of zero initialization influence.
Original formal slow requests were not traced individually. This capture identifies a directly observed same-scale collective-delay mechanism, not each original peak.
Later provider/HCA qualification logs belong to that separate test and do not retrofit the formal or diagnostic network identity.
